promise: Withdraw all US troops from Afghanistan by September 11, 2021
description: Biden announced the full withdrawal of US forces would be complete by the 20th anniversary of 9/11. The last troops departed on August 30, 2021 — ahead of the deadline, though the chaotic Kabul evacuation drew sharp criticism.
evidence: Last US troops left Kabul on 2021-08-30
Withdrawal completed before the September 11 deadline

promise: By the end of the summer, I want 70% of the adult population in the EU to be vaccinated
description: In her February 2021 European Parliament speech, von der Leyen set a target of fully vaccinating 70% of the EU's adult population by the end of summer 2021, despite a slow start to the bloc's rollout. The target was hit ahead of the autumn deadline: the EU reached 70% of adults fully vaccinated in late August 2021, thanks to a rapid acceleration of deliveries from the second quarter onward.
evidence: EU crossed the 70% of adults fully vaccinated mark on August 25, 2021
Over 200 million EU adults fully vaccinated before the end of September 2021

promise: Endurance electric pickup would begin production in September 2021, with deliveries starting the same month
description: Lordstown repeatedly told investors it was on track to start production of the Endurance in September 2021, even after Burns resigned in June 2021. Production did not begin in September 2021; limited production started only after a 2022 Foxconn agreement, and the company filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in June 2023 with only a small number of trucks delivered.
evidence: No production began in September 2021; company acknowledged needing capital in May 2021
Chapter 11 filing June 2023 after limited 2022 production
